memoryScope: Process peak RSS includes the runner, native runtime, weights and scratch buffers; not Flutter, TTS, extraction or a phone RAM requirement.

iosLimitation: EXPERIMENTAL simulator-only CPU port of published macOS ARM64 kernels, unchanged model weights. Not the Phonon-2 CoreML model and not a supported physical-iPhone build.
